University to Pilot Tablet-Based Exams Amid Leak Concerns

Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) plans to pilot a tablet-based examination system to prevent paper leaks. This move comes after recent exam irregularities. The university aims to test the feasibility of conducting exams using tablets, potentially eliminating the need for traditional paper question papers. The pilot program is intended to assess the effectiveness of this new system in ensuring exam integrity and preventing leaks.
